title: Master Itinerary
intro: 14 days, relaxed-cultural pace. Beijing (5 nights), Hanoi (2 nights), Đà Nẵng/Hội An resort base (5 nights). One anchor activity per day; outdoor activities mornings; midday rest/AC in Vietnam. Grab/DiDi only — no street taxis.

tables.caption: Beijing — Sept 1–6 (5 nights)
rows: Arrival — soft day; Wangfujing stroll; Forbidden City gates at dusk
Forbidden City + Jingshan Park + Nanluoguxiang Hutongs
Great Wall (Mutianyu) — cable car up, toboggan down
Temple of Heaven + shopping (Sanlitun / Parkview Green)
Transit — Beijing → Hanoi (soft day); Hoan Kiem Lake evening walk

tables.caption: Hanoi — Sept 6–8 (2 nights)
rows: Old Quarter + Hoan Kiem Lake + Temple of Literature
Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum morning → flight to Đà Nẵng (soft day)

tables.caption: Đà Nẵng / Hội An — Sept 8–13 (5 nights)
rows: Marble Mountains + Mỹ Khê Beach; resort pool midday
Hội An Ancient Town + tailor consultation (before 10 AM)
Tailor fitting + Son Trà Peninsula (Lady Buddha, douc langurs)
My Son Sanctuary early + Hội An tailor pickup
Final beach day + shopping + farewell dinner
Departure — Đà Nẵng DAD → Home (via ICN/NRT/TPE)

bullets.heading: Planning Principles
items: 70% rule: one anchor activity per day; afternoons flexible
Border crossing days (Sept 6, 8) are soft transit days
Great Wall on Day 3 — acclimatized, not jet-lagged
Each day includes wow moment, low-energy option, and rainy backup

bullets.heading: Book NOW
items: Mutianyu private car + cable car tickets + Peking duck reservation
Hanoi hotel (La Siesta Classic or Sofitel Metropole) + airport car
Domestic Vietnam flight Hanoi → Đà Nẵng (with international booking)

bullets.heading: Tailor Timeline (Hội An)
items: Day 10: Consultation (Yaly Couture, A Dong Silk, or Bebe Tailor)
Day 12: Final pickup — 2-day window minimum met

bullets.heading: Crowd & Heat Mitigation
items: Mutianyu over Badaling; Forbidden City timed entry booked early
Hội An before 10 AM; outdoor activities before 11 AM or after 4 PM

callouts.text: Transit 14% — under 20% threshold; no day exceeds 2 hrs in-city transit
First-day-in-country protocol: Days 1, 6, 8 all light/recovery days
PEK customs/immigration on first entry: 45–90 min — no dinner reservation before 8 PM on Day 1
September Vietnam: warm/humid with afternoon rain risk — rainy-day backups flagged per day
